rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority narrow by characterizing SB1 as an age-and-indication medical regulation not triggering heightened scrutiny (or applying intermediate scrutiny arguendo) and relying on Gonzales-style deference in a contested medical record. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito to press original-meaning and anti-doctrinal-expansion themes, and from Sotomayor (possibly with Kagan/Jackson) to argue SB1 is sex-based “in operation” under United States v. Virginia and fails intermediate scrutiny.
